_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Was pure flavour — one lines-only node — which is what made it the natural giver for the one quest that grew out of an existing complaint. ⚑ QUESTS (plan-quests.md C4): offers AND turns in `the-lost-lamp`, the three-conversant chain (he sends you to the Miner, the Miner points you at the kobolds, you come back here). Reward: the Lantern aura — until now a 5 % Kobold drop, i.e. a brutal gate on the light the tunnel is built around — plus 700 XP. It is also the only conversant with a `completed` node, because its original line ('The Kobolds took my lamp!') would become a lie the moment the lamp came back; that line now lives on the offer node, and root is state-neutral.
name: LamplessTraveller

grants.line: If I knew that I'd have gone and got it. The miner works this tunnel — ask him where they nest.

lines: The miner. He goes in there on purpose, which tells you what sort he is. He'll know where they nest.
North of the tunnel, he said? Then that's where it is. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting.
...That's it. That's the one. Give it here.

grants.line: There. There we are. Oh, that's better.
Now watch — a lamp isn't a thing you carry. It's a thing you learn. Hold it like so, and the dark stops being a wall.
Go on into that tunnel, then. It's only black until somebody walks in lit.

lines: Still here, aye. But lit. There's a difference, and you're the reason for it.
Sitting is free. Walking in the dark is not.
